abstract: Surgical exploration of a testicular mass should follow the basic principles of cancer surgery, including an inguinal approach, occlusion of the spermatic vessels, opening of the tunica vaginalis, and careful exploration of the testicle, epididymis, paratesticular structures, and spermatic cord. In a very few patients, when intratesticular lesion is small and moveable and can be seen through the tunica albuginea, and if there is a long history of scrotal mass, then the tunica albuginea should be opened and intratesticular exploration performed. The opening of the tunica albuginea should be opened and intratesticular exploration performed. The opening of the tunica albuginea does not violate the principles of cancer surgery, and for a few selected cases can prevent unnecessary orchiectomy. The incision of the tunica albuginea should no longer represent a surgical taboo to the urologist. Six cases of rare, benign intratesticular tumors are presented along with a rare indication for intratesticular exploration and testicle-preserving surgery.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘤の外科的探索は、がん手術の基本原則に従うべきであり、鼠径部アプローチ、精索血管の閉塞、精巣鞘膜の開放、精巣・精巣上体・精巣周囲構造および精索の慎重な探索を含む。ごく少数の患者では、精巣内病変が小さく可動性があり白膜を通して観察できる場合、また陰嚢腫瘤の既往が長い場合には、白膜を切開して精巣内探索を行うべきである。白膜の切開はがん手術の原則に反せず、選択された一部の症例では不要な精巣摘除術を防ぐことができる。白膜を切開して精巣内探索を行うことは、泌尿器科医にとってもはや外科的タブーであってはならない。稀な良性精巣内腫瘍6例と、精巣温存手術の稀な適応を併せて提示する。
